{{Quote|Shi Bata. He's a medic for CorSec. His wife died in the Imperial attack. You can trust him.|Nevis Kitt|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Shi Bata''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] living during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]] [[Shi Bata's wife]] died in the Imperial attack on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Shi Bata joined the Corellian resistance and went undercover as a medic in the [[Caicos Droid Factory]], now a makeshift hospital. He was contacted by [[Nevis Kitt]] and was asked to get the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Voidhound]] inside the heavily guarded factory. Shi Bata accomplished that by simply shooting the smuggler in a leg and bringing him in with the wounded, then patching it up while inside.
